Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the second WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly stated that the search results confirmed "Norris Bradbury was the director." This is a hallucination or a severe misinterpretation of the search results provided. The search results explicitly stated from Britannica: "J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of the laboratory at Los Alamos." The Planner failed to read the visible text correctly, confused the director (Oppenheimer) with the later director (Bradbury), and consequently provided the wrong final answer. The correct answer is J. Robert Oppenheimer.
